name: smwmusic-kirby-s-adventure-to-the-top-we-go-butter-building-remix
title: Kirby's Adventure - To The Top We Go! ~ Butter Building (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Butter Building from Kirby's Adventure. Was in the mood for some more Kirby music, so I thought I'd do another banger from Kirby's Adventure.

Super upbeat theme that makes you feel like you're climbing a tall tower.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. B Minor (Remix Pitch, turned on default)
2. C# Minor (Original Pitch)
2. D Minor (Kirby 64 Pitch)
